alt.en: A large gray monitor showing a branching graph stands at the center of a gray floor. On the left, a dashed orange line carrying one packet runs to it from a flat server. A dotted dark-gray arrow runs from the monitor to a stack of papers on the right, and a dotted light-gray line joins a teal terminal tile in front to the monitor.
alt.zh: 灰色地面中央立着一台大显示器，屏幕上是分支图。左侧一台扁平服务器经一条带数据包的橙色虚线连到显示器；一条深灰色点线箭头从显示器指向右侧的一叠纸；前方一块青色终端图块以浅灰色点线连到显示器。

caption.en: Illustration: an AI coding agent, shown as a terminal tile, prepares a symbolic execution run, shown on the monitor, over a Python application, shown as a server, and the run yields a concrete test, shown as papers. It does not depict the researchers' harness or a tested deployment, and it does not show that the reported results hold.
caption.zh: 示意图：终端图块代表 AI 编程智能体，它为一个 Python 应用（服务器）准备符号执行运行（显示器），运行得出具体测试（纸张）。本图并不描绘研究人员的框架或经过测试的部署，也不表明报告中的结果成立。
